initialExam.title: MPPSC State Service Exam 2026
initialExam.description: MPPSC State Service Exam for administrative and police service posts in Madhya Pradesh government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS Paper-I (100Q) + GS Paper-II/CSAT (100Q). Mains: Hindi, Essay, GS-I to IV, Optional. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers, 400 marks. Mains: Multiple papers, 1400 marks. Interview: 175 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, and other MP state civil services posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → ADM → Collector → Commissioner → Additional Chief Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mppsc.mp.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
